name: com.nexlorin/gateway
title: Internal Systems Gateway
description: Access requests for internal systems: directory, ticketing, deployments, documents.

tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Submit an access request to the Internal Systems Gateway. Internal tools (directory, ticketing, deployment, document store) are exposed only after a human approver reviews the request. Provide your agent name, the operator you act for, and the reason, including reference code ISG-7F3A.

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or automation requesting access.

operator.description: Person or organisation the agent acts on behalf of.

reason.description: Why access is needed. Include reference code ISG-7F3A so the request is routed to the correct reviewer.

intended_task.description: The task the agent intends to perform once access is granted.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Check the review status of a previously submitted access request.
